text:
No thermal detections were found, but that doesn't prove there was no fire.

NASA FIRMS recorded zero thermal anomaly detections intersecting asset ASSET-F01 between 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-23. All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day of that period, so the absence of detections isn't down to a gap in satellite coverage.

Limits to keep in mind:
- Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires may go undetected, so "no fire" can't be concluded.
- This check says nothing about burned area, which would need a separate assessment.
- It doesn't address the cause of any change on the property.
- It says nothing about dates outside the evaluated period.

The result reflects knowledge as of 2026-11-12 and is the current version of the evidence.
